standard_prerequisites.name: Standard permanence and tensor facts for universally injective maps and faithfully flat ring maps
standard_prerequisites.use: Cited at proof lines 1877-1902 for permanence under a further localisation, for faithful flatness from the condition on spectra, for universally injective maps induced by faithfully flat ring maps and for composition; none of them contains the reduction or the diagram chase of this proof.

core_obligations: Set up the two-stage diagram: put N' = N tensor_R S' and consider the commutative square with N, N', and their Sigma-localisations, where Sigma is the set of elements of S that are not zerodivisors on N/m_R N; show it suffices to prove that N -> Sigma^{-1}N' is universally injective, using permanence under the further localisation (proof lines 1867-1878).

Make Sigma^{-1}S -> Sigma^{-1}S' faithfully flat: the maximal ideals of the semi-local ring Sigma^{-1}S correspond to associated primes of N/m_R N, and the hypothesis on the image of Spec(S') -> Spec(S) says that Spec(Sigma^{-1}S') -> Spec(Sigma^{-1}S) hits all of them, so the localised ring map is faithfully flat; hence Sigma^{-1}N -> Sigma^{-1}N' is universally injective (proof lines 1881-1896).

Compose: apply the homothety universal-injectivity lemma to N -> Sigma^{-1}N and close the composition N -> Sigma^{-1}N' with the composition rule for universally injective module maps, concluding that N -> N' is R-universally injective (proof lines 1897-1903).
proof_roadmap: Introduce N' = N tensor_R S' and the commutative square of localisations along Sigma, reducing to universal injectivity of N -> Sigma^{-1}N' by permanence of universal injectivity under localisation (proof lines 1867-1878).

Use the semi-locality of Sigma^{-1}S and the assumption that Spec(S') -> Spec(S) hits every associated prime of N/m_R N lying over m_R to get faithful flatness of Sigma^{-1}S -> Sigma^{-1}S'; faithfully flat ring maps have universally injective module maps for the tensor product, so Sigma^{-1}N -> Sigma^{-1}N' is universally injective (proof lines 1881-1896).
Combine with universal injectivity of N -> Sigma^{-1}N and with closure of universal injectivity under composition to conclude for N -> N' (proof lines 1897-1903).
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion for N -> N tensor_S S' to be R-universally injective when S -> S' is flat and meets every associated prime of the fibre N/m_R N over the local base (statement lines 1852-1863). The proof is a genuine three-stage reduction: the map is replaced by its Sigma-localisation, the localised ring map Sigma^{-1}S -> Sigma^{-1}S' is shown faithfully flat by matching the maximal ideals of the semi-local ring Sigma^{-1}S with the associated primes of the fibre, and faithful flatness supplies universal injectivity of the tensor map, after which the two remaining pieces are glued by the composition rule (proof lines 1881-1903). No step is a computation; the content is the organisation of six quoted algebra lemmas around one commutative square, so the claim is H2.
